test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pandit Bhimsen Joshi who received Bharat Ratna in 2009 was popular for the khayal form of singing and belonged to the ______ Gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Joshi **who received Bharat Ratna in 2009 was popular for the khayal form of singing and belonged to the Kirana Gharana. 
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Gururaj Joshi, **often known by his honorific title Pandit, was one of the best vocalists in the Hindustani classical genre.
 
• Both his popular versions of devotional music and his khayal style of singing are what make him famous (bhajans and abhangs).
 
• A well-known performer, Joshi travelled to Afghanistan, Italy, France, Canada, and the United States between 1964 and 1982.
 
• He was the first musician from India whose concerts in New York City were promoted through posters.
 
• In honour of his teacher, Sawai Gandharva, Joshi played a key role in the annual Sawai Gandharva Music Festival's establishment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• One of the Indian classical khyal gharanas is** Kirana, **and it places a high priority on note intonation (swara).
 
• One of the oldest Khyal Gharanas in Indian classical music is **the Gwalior Gharana**. The Mughal emperor Akbar's (1542–1605) reign marked the beginning of the Gwalior Gharana's ascent.
 
• One of the vocal gharanas (traditions, schools, or musical styles) of Hindustani classical music is called the **Patiala Gharana** after the city of Patiala in Punjab, India, where it originated.
 
• The Nauhar Bani is the ancestor of the **Agra Gharana, **a school of Hindustani classical vocal music.
